Initial release of phy-flag-janitor: detect and clean up dead feature flags from codebases.

- Scans code and config to find flags that are always-on, always-off, only in tests, undefined, or unused.
- Supports LaunchDarkly, Unleash, Flagsmith, environment-variable flags, and custom flag patterns.
- Works entirely from local files and git history; no external API needed.
- Generates prioritized cleanup recommendations with exact code locations and safe-delete confirmation commands.
- Trigger via natural language or /flag-janitor command.
